source: data symbols of the statically linked binary, read by name (nm) from the ELF file
layout: per-element arrays index Z-1 (Z=1..103 for tblite_xtb_gxtb, 1..118 for dftd4); multi-dimensional arrays given in Fortran order flattened, shape listed

pa_rep_cn.note: repulsion k^CN_A (alpha scaling with sqrt CN)

pa_cn_rcov.note: CN radii (bohr) of the repulsion CN (erf, kcn 2.068); shared with other g-xTB CN users

pa_rvdw_scale.note: scaling of mctc D3 pair radii (bohr): Rv_AB = R^D3_AB * (s_A + s_B)/2; used by repulsion (and other terms)

d4_tanh_params.note: a, b, c, d of n(q) = a + b tanh(c q + d)

diff_vs_v1.1.element_parameters: all pa_rep_*, pa_increment, pa_cn_rcov refitted (no value identical to v1.1 gxtb_parameters except zeros); see notes
